packageRules.description: Keep container images on the latest minor and patch release with pinned digests
Hold primeicons on 7.x, its last MIT release: 8.0.0 moved to the commercial PrimeUI license, which a GPL-3.0-or-later project cannot ship
Hold PrimeVue on 4.x, its last MIT release: 5.0.0 moved to the commercial PrimeUI license, which a GPL-3.0-or-later project cannot ship
Hold the PrimeVue themes on 2.x, their last MIT release: 3.0.0 moved to the commercial PrimeUI license, which a GPL-3.0-or-later project cannot ship

Hold remixicon on 4.8.x, its last Apache-2.0 release: 4.9.0 replaced the license text with one of its own that adds restrictions, which a GPL-3.0-or-later project cannot ship, while still declaring Apache-2.0
Leave playwright alone: the npm pin has to name the version nixpkgs builds the browsers for, and the flake.lock job is what moves it
Only security updates on release branches
